title: Providers
subtitle: The credential a session launches with. Register it once; the engine seals it and hands it to the agent at launch.

empty.title: No provider registered yet
empty.description: A session cannot launch without a credential. Add the API key of Anthropic, OpenAI or xAI — or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — and the engine seals it and uses it at launch. The key is never shown again.

emptyFiltered.title: No provider matches this filter
emptyFiltered.description: Clear the filter to see every registered provider.

forbidden.title: You cannot read the providers of this tenant
forbidden.description: Reading registered providers needs sessions:provider:read. Ask an administrator of this tenant for it.

kindHints.openai_compatible: Any OpenAI-shaped endpoint. Injects OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL; the endpoint is required.

probe.neverHint: Nobody has tested this credential. Registering it is not evidence that it works.
probe.okHint: The provider answered and accepted this credential.
probe.refusedHint: The provider answered and rejected this credential. Rotate it.
probe.unreachableHint: The endpoint did not answer. This says nothing about the credential.

create.title: Add a provider
create.description: The engine seals the key and never returns it. You will see a four-character hint and nothing more.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Your own name for this credential. It is what a picker shows.
create.baseURLHint: Leave empty for the provider's official endpoint. Must be https.
create.apiKeyHint: Sent once, sealed by the engine, never returned to this browser.
create.success: Provider registered. Test the connection to confirm it works.

rotate.title: Rotate this provider's key
rotate.description: The new key replaces the old one under the same reference, so every profile bound to it keeps working. A session already running keeps the credential it started with.
rotate.verdictCleared: The previous connection test is cleared: a verdict measured on a credential that no longer exists is not evidence about the one replacing it.
rotate.success: Key rotated. Test the connection to confirm the new one works.

revoke.title: Revoke this provider
revoke.description: This destroys the sealed credential. It cannot be undone for this reference.
revoke.consequence: Every provider profile bound to it will refuse to launch, naming this provider. The credential is not revoked at the provider itself: do that in their own console.
revoke.success: Provider revoked and its sealed credential destroyed.

detail.title: Provider
detail.noModels: No model list yet. Test the connection.

vaultUnavailable.title: This deployment cannot store a provider credential
vaultUnavailable.description: No sealed credential vault is wired, so the engine refuses to store a key rather than storing one it cannot protect. An administrator must configure the secret sealer.

next.title: Next: deploy an agent
next.description: A credential on its own does not launch anything. Bind it to a provider profile, and a session launched under that profile uses it.

truncation.label: Showing {{n}} providers; there are more
truncation.hint: This list is one page. Narrow it, or use `olivares provider ls` for the full set.
